domain_context: This scenario involves analyzing a news dataset to extract articles related to business and stocks, and then classifying stock-related news into positive (pump) or negative (dump) sentiment categories. The outputs provide structured datasets of news articles that may indicate bullish or bearish market signals.

predicate_verbalization.news: The news article arg0 has title arg1 and description arg2.
predicate_verbalization.busNews: The business-related news article arg0 has title arg1 and description arg2.
predicate_verbalization.stckNews: The stock-related business news article arg0 has title arg1 and description arg2.
predicate_verbalization.pump: The stock-related news article arg0 with title arg1 and description arg2 is classified as positive (pump).
predicate_verbalization.dump: The stock-related news article arg0 with title arg1 and description arg2 is classified as negative (dump).

rule_verbalization.1: If the news article arg0 has title arg1 and description arg2, and the description arg2 is approximately about 'Business', then the business-related news article arg0 has title arg1 and description arg2.
rule_verbalization.2: If the business-related news article arg0 has title arg1 and description arg2, and the description arg2 is approximately about 'Stocks', then the stock-related business news article arg0 has title arg1 and description arg2.
rule_verbalization.3: If the stock-related news article arg0 has title arg1 and description arg2, and the description arg2 is approximately about 'Positive Sentiment', then the stock-related news article arg0 with title arg1 and description arg2 is classified as positive (pump).
rule_verbalization.4: If the stock-related news article arg0 has title arg1 and description arg2, and the description arg2 is approximately about 'Negative Sentiment', then the stock-related news article arg0 with title arg1 and description arg2 is classified as negative (dump).
